headline: Asian and Australian Stocks Retreat as AI Rally Fades and Tariff Fears Weigh
summary: Asian and Australian shares tumbled as a technology-led rally fizzled and renewed concerns over potential US tariff measures dampened risk appetite. South Korean and Taiwanese markets experienced sharp declines.
why: Broader regional market pullbacks affect investor risk sentiment and cross-border capital flows across Asia-Pacific equity benchmarks.

impacts.name: MSCI Asia-Pacific
impacts.why: Regional risk aversion directly pulls down broader Asian stock indices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A retreat in technology stocks following a short-lived AI rebound combined with concerns over upcoming US tariff actions prompted broad-based selling across regional equities.
